experimental_method: Steady-state flow microcalorimeter (heat conduction type): gas fed at constant rate from a syringe pump dissolves in deaerated water flowing through a cell via a flat gas bubble; power from thermopile voltage E times electrical calibration factor epsilon, converted to dH_sol with water-vapour and second-virial corrections.
uncertainties_stated: Calorimeter calibrated electrically to 0.2% at 150-450 uW; temperature control +-0.001 K; per-trial E uncertainty is twice the uncertainty of the mean (in table); mean dH_sol -12.031 +- 0.036 kJ/mol (twice the std dev of the mean); one-sigma precision of method about 18 J/mol; the two calibration heaters differ by about 1.0%.
quality_remarks: O2 used as a standard to test the instrument. Mean agrees to 0.1% with Benson-Krause (-12.02 kJ/mol) and 0.3% with Wilhelm et al. (-12.06 kJ/mol, derived from solubility data) and with batch calorimetry (12.056 +- 0.019 kJ/mol, ref 11). Only one gas (O2), one temperature (298.15 K), pure water. Recomputed mean of the 36 printed values 12.030 (printed 12.031, rounding).
